canonical_hazards.name: Inland / Riverine / Cloudburst Flooding
canonical_hazards.description: Excess overland surface water accumulation due to heavy monsoon cloudbursts or river overflow.

canonical_hazards.name: Meteorological & Hydrological Drought
canonical_hazards.description: Prolonged rainfall deficit causing soil moisture loss and agricultural water stress.

canonical_hazards.name: Extreme High Temperature Events
canonical_hazards.description: Periods of abnormally high ambient temperatures exceeding seasonal thresholds.

canonical_hazards.name: Storm Surge & Tidal Inundation
canonical_hazards.description: Coastal land submergence caused by storm surge waves, high tides, or sea-level rise.

canonical_hazards.name: Shoreline Soil & Beach Loss
canonical_hazards.description: Loss of coastal beach and intertidal land area due to wave action and littoral drift.

canonical_hazards.name: Groundwater Depletion & Supply Deficit
canonical_hazards.description: Severe deficit in surface and groundwater availability for domestic and agricultural consumption.

canonical_hazards.name: Urban Heat Island Effect
canonical_hazards.description: Micro-climate thermal elevation in dense urban built environments.
